description: This file contains utility methods for handling ByteBuffer objects, including cloning, creating empty buffers, and converting buffers to UTF-8 strings.

classes.name: ByteBufferUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to manipulate ByteBuffer instances, including cloning, creating empty buffers, and converting to UTF-8 strings.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a deep clone of the given ByteBuffer. Handles both array-backed and direct buffers.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty ByteBuffer of size zero.

methods.name: toUtf8String
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuffer into a UTF-8 encoded String, returning null if the input is null.
